description: The two discordant anchors of the original kappa fit reconcile once the Coulomb energy of 3He's pp pair is restored. What survives is an excess-INDEPENDENT offset of order 0.2 MeV, same sign at both anchors despite opposite excess, so it cannot be an excess-proportional coupling. The published kappa was un-subtracted Coulomb.

parameters.alpha_em_provenance: derived from q_0 in coulomb_energy, not CODATA

radius_models.name: implied by the measured 3He charge radius

by_radius_model.radius_model: implied by the measured 3He charge radius

data.finding: The published kappa ~ -1.0708 MeV was un-subtracted Coulomb. Removing it leaves an excess-independent offset that cannot be a coupling to the p/n asymmetry, and that is 3-15x smaller than the published value. This diagnoses both earlier negatives: the mirror-split test found no room because the coefficient is zero, and the original fit refuted itself because it was fitting electrostatics with a categorical form.

assertions.name: corrected_residuals_share_a_sign_under_every_radius_model
assertions.detail: the anchors carry excess +1 and -1; an excess-proportional term must flip sign between them. After Coulomb removal both residuals are negative under all three radius models, so the surviving quantity is not proportional to the excess

assertions.name: derived_radius_reconciles_the_anchors_to_the_4He_noise_floor
assertions.detail: gap 0.0211 MeV vs the 4He residual 0.0223 MeV, measured where the excess vanishes identically and no kappa term exists by construction

assertions.name: surviving_offset_is_far_smaller_than_the_published_kappa
assertions.detail: published |kappa| = 1.0708 MeV; the corrected 3He residual is 0.07-0.39 MeV, 3-15x smaller, under every radius model

assertions.name: the_3He_arm_was_dominated_by_coulomb
assertions.detail: the derived Coulomb energy 0.8474 MeV is 79% of the published kappa -- the fitted 'coupling' is mostly electrostatics
